proposedManifest.name: VisionQuest
proposedManifest.description: West Coast Avengers' Vision Quest and Tom King's Vision underpin Marvel Studios' Disney+ series VisionQuest, preparing you for Vision's search for identity and family. Begin with the twins' birth and loss, then Vision's dismantling and reconstruction, Billy and Tommy's return in Young Avengers, their reunion with Wanda in The Children's Crusade, and Vision's new synthezoid family. Five selected Vision Quest issues have owner-confirmed identities but no provider details or covers.

insertionReview.rationale: Approved the exact beforeId avengers-doomsday-secret-wars after reading the actual manifest and maintained release associations. The anchor exists as a screen companion, and the supplied US October 13, 2026 VisionQuest premiere falls after Brand New Day and before December 18 Doomsday. The parent must add the planned independent release association/fixture; manifest position is not assumed to be global release chronology. This insertion preserves existing guide order and does not reorder the owner's comic sequence.
